description: One call, one consolidated due-diligence pack: (1) a read-only capability map of one public website or API - entry points, forms, MCP tools, auth behaviour, with the evidence behind every claim; (2) the on-chain balances of one EVM address, read from the chain at a stated block height with contract decimals read on-chain, not assumed. Give either target or both. Paid per call via x402 (USDC on Base, no account, no API key). 【価格】1.00 USDC。【使い方】呼ぶと 402 と PAYMENT-REQUIRED（支払い条件）が返る。USDC で支払い、同じ引数に PAYMENT-SIGNATURE ヘッダを添えて再送すると結果が返る。
name: diligence-pack
